notes: Created implementation plan covering two change requests: (1) 9 review follow-up items from title changes (MARGIN dedup, offscreen canvas optimization, test import alignment, Enter key flicker, truncation toast, newline docs, ARIA states, label text, touch targets) and (2) progress bar overlay when adding images. Plan organized into 3 phases: Phase 1 (code quality, P1), Phase 2 (UX + accessibility, P0), Phase 3 (progress bar, P0). Each phase includes Given-When-Then behavior scenarios, specific file paths with line numbers, and automated/manual success criteria. Consulted world-review for UX prioritization and planner for technical approach. Key decisions: MARGIN stays in TitleRenderer.js (not SizeConstants.js), progress bar uses per-image counting (not byte-level), touch targets use pointerType detection, Enter key guard uses @keydown handler with line-count check.
